name: supabase
description: The Postgres development platform. Supabase gives you a dedicated Postgres database to build your web, mobile, and AI applications.
one_liner: An all-in-one backend for apps, database, user logins, file storage, and instant APIs, so a developer can launch a real app without hand-building server infrastructure.
buyer: A solo developer or small startup building a web or mobile app who needs a working backend fast without hiring backend engineers.
business_use_cases: An indie developer launches an MVP in days by using it for login, database, and file storage instead of building each piece separately.
A no-code/low-code agency builds client apps faster by using it as the standard backend, cutting delivery time on every project.
A startup building an AI product uses its vector/embeddings toolkit as the storage layer for an AI feature, skipping separate vector-database infrastructure.

money_ideas.idea: Offer 'launch your app backend in a week' setup services for non-technical founders
Build and sell app templates pre-wired with authentication, database, and payments on top of it

steal_this: This weekend, build a niche app starter template (e.g. for booking systems or membership sites) pre-configured on it and sell it to other indie builders.
